subject: Charged for annual instead of monthly
body: Hello, I signed up for the Team plan three days ago and picked monthly billing, but my card was charged 2,388 USD for a full year. Could you switch me to monthly and refund the difference? Thank you.

subject: API down for everyone!!
body: Your API has been returning 503 errors for ALL of our users since 09:10 UTC. Our drivers cannot load their routes. This is completely unacceptable, fix it immediately.

subject: Love the product - dark mode?
body: Hey team! Big fans of Northwind here. Any chance you could add a dark mode to the dashboard? Our designers work late and would love it. Keep up the great work!

subject: RIDICULOUS invoice logo
body: THIS IS RIDICULOUS. The logo on our invoice PDF is blurry and looks unprofessional. I am absolutely furious. Fix it NOW or we are taking our business elsewhere!!!

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hi, I'm locked out of my own account and the password reset email never arrives. Everyone else on my team can log in fine. Can you help me get back in?

subject: Add VAT number to invoices
body: Hello, whenever convenient, could you add our VAT number GB 123 4567 89 to our future invoices? No rush at all. Many thanks.

subject: Small question about access
body: Hi, sorry to bother you, no rush really, but our whole finance team has been locked out since this morning and payroll has to run by 5pm today. Thanks so much!

subject: Possible leaked API key
body: Hello, just a heads up: one of our engineers noticed that a Northwind production API key was committed to a public GitHub repo about two hours ago. We have removed the commit. What should we do next?

subject: WHO moved the Settings button??
body: Why on earth did you move the Settings button to the left sidebar?? Absolutely infuriating. It took me five minutes to find it. Terrible UI change.

subject: XLSX export fails for one report
body: Hi, exporting the 'Quarterly Revenue' report to XLSX gives an error. CSV export of the same report works, so we are using that for now. Could you take a look?

subject: Okta SSO next quarter
body: Hi, we're planning to roll out Okta across the firm next quarter. Do you support Okta SSO, and if not, is it on the roadmap?

subject: Quick question when you have a sec
body: Hi there, quick question when you have a moment: our nightly backups have failed for the last three nights. We have an external audit tomorrow at 9am and the auditors will ask for them. Appreciate any help!

subject: You charged us TWICE
body: I can't believe this. You charged our company card 4,800 USD TWICE this month. Refund the duplicate right now. This is the kind of sloppiness that makes me want to cancel.

subject: Webhooks delayed in EU
body: Hello, since about 07:00 CET all webhooks from your EU region are arriving 2 hours late. None of our customer orders are syncing to the warehouse. Could you check?

subject: How do I add a teammate?
body: Hi, how do I invite a new teammate to our workspace? I couldn't find it in the docs. Thanks!

subject: Refund for unused months
body: Hi, we bought an annual Business plan two months ago but we are moving to a different tool. Can we get a refund for the unused months?

subject: Nobody can log in
body: After this morning's SSO certificate rotation, none of our 300 employees can log in to Northwind. The SAML login just loops. We need this fixed ASAP.

subject: Still no Gantt view?!
body: It's 2026 and you STILL don't have a Gantt chart view. Seriously frustrating. Every competitor has one. Add it already.

subject: Reports page very slow
body: Hi, for our analytics team (6 people) the Reports page takes about 20 seconds to load since Monday. It does load eventually and everything else is fast. Could you look into it?

subject: Upgrading to Enterprise
body: Hi, we're really happy with Northwind and are thinking of moving to the Enterprise plan next month. Could someone send me pricing for 150 seats?
